sentences.zh: 你在宾夕法尼亚州的一个小农场长大，但你并非出身于农耕家庭。

sentences.en: James, you say that after meeting Michael Stokes, you reflected on how his life could have been your life.
sentences.zh: 我理解这在你的社区里造成了一些问题？

sentences.en: Take me back to your childhood.
You grew up on a small farm in Pennsylvania, but you did not come from a farming family.
And I understand this posed something of a problem in your community?

sentences.zh: 我12岁时，父母把我带到了农场。

sentences.en: So I moved to this farm.
sentences.zh: 那是一个成长的好地方。

sentences.en: My folks moved me to the farm when I was 12 years old.
sentences.zh: 我们有一群牛，安格斯黑牛。

sentences.en: And I grew up on that farm.
And it was a good place to grow up.
We had a herd of cattle, Black Angus cattle.
sentences.zh: 对一个男孩来说，那是个很棒的地方。
我在那里度过了一段美好的时光。
但我从那段经历中想要得到的一件事，是真正与周围的农场孩子交朋友。

sentences.en: It was a great place to be a boy.
sentences.zh: 在农场长大有点与世隔绝，因为住家之间距离很远。

sentences.en: And I had a good time there.
sentences.zh: 但我开始在学校见到他们，并真的试图与他们交朋友。

sentences.en: But one of the things I wanted out of that experience was to really befriend the farm kids around me.
sentences.zh: 我开始像他们一样打扮，穿那种农民穿的靴子和牛仔裤，你知道，

sentences.en: It was a bit of an isolated experience growing up on a farm because the distances are great between homes.
sentences.zh: 还有法兰绒衬衫、拖拉机帽之类的东西，听乡村音乐。

sentences.en: But I began to meet them in school and really tried to befriend them.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，他们并不打算让我这个外人以那种方式进入他们的社区。

sentences.en: I began to dress like them, wearing, you know, farmer's kinds of boots and jeans and, you know,
sentences.zh: 而这一点可能因为一个事实而加剧了，那就是我们并没有靠农场为生，我的家庭不是靠农场生活的。

sentences.en: like flannel shirts and tractor hats and all that kind of stuff and listening to country music.
sentences.zh: 我父亲其实是一名保险代理人。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, they were not going to have me, an outsider, come into this community in that way.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，他早上10点左右才去镇上，穿着西装，而他们的父亲凌晨4点就起床了，

sentences.en: And that was probably exacerbated by the fact that we didn't make, my family didn't make our living from the farm.
sentences.zh: 在挤奶厅里，你知道，双脚陷在粪便里给牛挤奶。

sentences.en: My dad was actually an insurance agent.
sentences.zh: 所以他们把我排斥在他们的社区之外，这已经够痛苦了。

sentences.en: So, you know, he was going into the local town, maybe 10 a.m., dressed in a suit, and their dads were up at 4 a.m.
sentences.zh: 但最终，随着我在高中长大，他们开始欺负我。

sentences.en: and out in the milking parlor, you know, knee-deep in manure, milking the cows.
sentences.zh: 那么，在你17岁那年的一天晚上，你和父母及兄弟在家。

sentences.en: So they kept me out of their community, and that was painful enough.
sentences.zh: 你当时正在床上睡觉，但被一声巨响惊醒了。

sentences.en: But eventually, they took to bullying me as I got older in high school.
So one night when you were 17 years old, you were home with your parents and brother.
You were sleeping in bed, but you awoke to a loud noise.
sentences.zh: 它，你知道，把我们从床上震了下来。
我们走到窗边看发生了什么事。

sentences.en: Yeah, that noise was a gunshot.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当我看向窗外时，我看到了一辆皮卡车，那是学校里一直骚扰和欺负我的家伙之一的。

sentences.en: It, you know, knocked us out of bed.
sentences.zh: 我看到那辆车消失在夜色中，我们检查了房子周围看看有没有损坏。

sentences.en: We went to the windows to see what was going on.
sentences.zh: 我们什么也没发现，就回去睡觉了。

sentences.en: And, you know, when I looked out the window, I saw a pickup truck owned by one of the guys who had been harassing me and bullying me in school.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上发生了什么？

sentences.en: I saw the truck taking off into the night, and we checked around the house to see if there was any damage.
sentences.zh: 所以，我每天早上上学前的工作之一就是照顾动物，给它们喂食喂水。

sentences.en: And we didn't find any and went back to bed.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我走到谷仓去给牛和猪喂食喂水。
外面还有一个狗圈，我们养了一只漂亮的猎兔犬，名叫宝拉（Paula）。

sentences.en: So one of my jobs before going to school in the morning was to take care of the animals and feed and water them.
sentences.zh: 当我走到她的围栏时，我发现她死在围栏里，倒在血泊中，头上有一个弹孔。

sentences.en: And, you know, I went out to the barn to feed and water the cows and the pigs.
sentences.zh: 那一刻你感觉如何，詹姆斯？

sentences.en: And there was also a dog pen out there where we kept this beautiful beagle hunting dog named Paula.
And when I went to her pen, I found her lying dead in the pen in a pool of blood with a bullet hole through her head.
sentences.zh: 亲眼目睹自己的狗被杀是一件极其可怕的事情。

sentences.en: How did you feel in that moment, James?
sentences.zh: 知道是谁杀了她，以及为什么。

sentences.en: Seeing your dog killed is a terrible thing to witness.
sentences.zh: 但他们为什么要做到这种地步，这种可怕的地步，仅仅为了杀一只无辜的狗来向我示威，或者对我进行报复，或者无论他们脑子里在想什么，

sentences.en: Knowing who killed her and why.
These are guys who were my enemies.
sentences.zh: 几周后，你独自在家，听到有车辆靠近房子。

sentences.en: But why would they go to such a length, a horrific length to kill an innocent dog just to make a point with me or retaliate against me or whatever was in their heads,

sentences.zh: 是的，有一辆车开了过来，当我起身看向窗外想看发生什么事时，我看到了那辆同样的皮卡车。

sentences.en: A couple of weeks later, you were at home alone and you heard a vehicle approach the house.
sentences.zh: 但随后是一道闪光和一声爆炸。
他们炸毁了我们的邮箱，并把它射进了邻近的玉米地里。

sentences.en: Yeah, there was a vehicle that came up and as I was getting up to look out the window and see what was happening, I saw that same pickup truck.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那算是到头了。

sentences.en: But then there was a flash and an explosion.
sentences.zh: 我已经忍受他们的虐待，我不知道，有三四年了。

sentences.en: They had blown up our mailbox and shot it into the neighboring cornfield.
That was kind of it for me.
sentences.zh: 我试图抵制他们的所作所为，但从未采取任何暴力方式。

sentences.en: I had been putting up with their abuse for, I don't know, three or four years now.
sentences.zh: 但现在发生了这一切，我决定我再也无法忍受了，我必须采取更极端的措施。

sentences.en: I tried to resist what they were doing, but never in any type of a violent way.
sentences.zh: 我从大约八岁起就开始玩枪和打猎。

sentences.en: But now with everything that had happened, I decided that I couldn't deal with this any longer and I'd have to go to a much more extreme measure.
I'd been on that farm since I was a young kid.
sentences.zh: 我父亲的床头柜里有一把装满子弹的手枪，而且我当时是一个人。

sentences.en: I'd been shooting guns and hunting since I was about eight years old.
sentences.zh: 所以我跑过去，从床头柜里抓起它，那天晚上跳进我母亲的车里，开车追了过去。

sentences.en: And we had plenty of guns in the house.
My dad had a loaded handgun in his nightstand and I was all alone.
So I ran up, I grabbed it out of the nightstand, jumped in my mother's car that night, and I drove off after them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在那一刻，计划是去和他们对质。

sentences.en: What were you trying to do?
sentences.zh: 我不认为在制定那个计划时，我在开车阶段对我要做什么有明确的构想。
但计划，你知道，在我真正能够追上他们并将他们逼到他们农场的一个谷仓边时，开始变得更加具体了。

sentences.en: Well, at that point, the plan was to confront them.
And I don't think that as I was putting that plan together, I had a clear vision of what I was going to do at the stage of driving.
sentences.zh: 他们的车背对着我，所以我看到，你知道，车窗里有他们的头影，我的远光灯照在他们的车尾上。

sentences.en: But the plan, you know, started to formulate more closely when I was actually able to catch up to them and I cornered them against a barn on one of their farMs.
sentences.zh: 他们爬了出来，你知道，开始眯着眼透过我的前大灯看是谁在这条长长的农场路上追赶他们。

sentences.en: There were three or four of them in the pickup truck.
sentences.zh: 我花了一些时间才追上他们，他们可能看不清楚，

sentences.en: Their truck was facing away from me, so I saw, you know, its foreheads in the window with my bright beams on the back of their truck.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他们不知道到底是谁开车到那里，或者他们所看到的那辆车驾驶座上坐的是谁。

sentences.en: They climbed out and, you know, started squinting through my headlights to see who had chased them down this long farm road.
sentences.zh: 但很明显他们没有武器，而且他们不知道我有枪。

sentences.en: It had taken some time for me to catch up to them, and they probably didn't have clear visibility,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我开始下车，心想这将是我复仇的机会。

sentences.en: so I don't think that they knew exactly who had driven there or who was behind the wheel of that car that they were looking at.
sentences.zh: 就在我下车的时候，我有了这种洞察。

sentences.en: But it was clear that they were unarmed, and they did not know that I had a gun.
sentences.zh: 我几乎能预见我的未来，我意识到如果我做了我想做的事，如果我枪杀了他们，我也等于是在自杀。

sentences.en: You know, I started to get out with the idea that this would be my opportunity to get revenge.
sentences.zh: 即使不是肉体上的，我的身份，那个我在这之前认识的詹姆斯·金梅尔二世，

sentences.en: And as I was getting out of the car, I had this insight.
sentences.zh: 将永远不再是那个人了。

sentences.en: I could almost see into my future, and I realized that if I did what I wanted to do, if I had gunned them down, I would be killing myself as well.
sentences.zh: 我将不得不永远以杀人犯的身份认识自己。

sentences.en: If not physically, then my identity, the James Kimmel Jr.
sentences.zh: 那不是我愿意接受的身份。

sentences.en: that I knew before that moment, would no longer be that guy ever again.
sentences.zh: 我受到的教育比那更好，我很快就能看出，这真的不会让我处于更好的境地。

sentences.en: I'd always have to know myself as a murderer.
sentences.zh: 这会比我当时所处的境地还要糟糕得多。

sentences.en: That was not an identity that I was willing to accept for myself.
sentences.zh: 而那种顿悟足以让我把枪放下，你知道，把腿缩回车里，关上车门，开车回家。

sentences.en: I had been raised better than that, and I could see quickly that it really wouldn't put me in a better position.
sentences.zh: 所以你和迈克尔·斯托克斯在某些方面有着同样的复仇冲动。

sentences.en: It would be far worse than I was already sitting in.
sentences.zh: 显然，你处理这些冲动的方式非常、非常不同。

sentences.en: And that realization was just enough to cause me to put the gun back down, you know, pull my leg back in the car, shut the door, and drive back home.
sentences.zh: 但我了解到，后来在生活中，你最终成为了一名律师，你发现法律在某种程度上是你实现复仇能力的一种方式？

sentences.en: So you and Michael Stokes, in some ways, shared the same impulse for revenge.
You obviously handled those impulses very, very differently.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在我们的社会中，律师被赋予了，你知道，这种非常强大的复仇许可。

sentences.en: But I understand that later on in life, you eventually became a lawyer, and you found that the law was a way, in some ways, to enact your capacity for vengeance and revenge?
sentences.zh: 我们是唯一被授权并允许以复仇形式开具、制造和分发正义的职业。

sentences.en: You know, lawyers are given in our society, you know, this very powerful license to get revenge.
sentences.zh: 而且我们为此获得了丰厚的报酬。

sentences.en: We're the only profession that's authorized and allowed to prescribe and manufacture and distribute justice in the form of revenge.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢成为律师这个想法，部分原因是，
因为那天晚上我和那些农场孩子之间的事情归根结底是，我只是不愿意支付我非法用枪复仇所必须付出的高昂代价。

sentences.en: And we get paid a lot of money for doing that.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我仍然想要复仇，我非常渴望向他们复仇，而且作为一个年轻人，在这一点上，某种程度上也是向世界复仇。

sentences.en: And I love the idea of becoming a lawyer, in part,
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是一种男性的愤怒，觉得一切都在与你作对。

sentences.en: because what it came down to for me that night with the farm kids is that I just wasn't willing to pay the high price that I'd have to pay to get revenge with a gun illegally.
sentences.zh: 我认为迈克尔·斯托克斯感受到的愤怒也是如此，觉得一切都在与我作对，我必须对此做点什么，我要报复。

sentences.en: But, you know, I still wanted revenge, and I wanted it badly against them, and kind of against the world at this point as a young man.
You know, it's that kind of that male rage that everything's arrayed against you.
sentences.zh: 所以你在法庭上找到了增加代价、压力和痛苦的方法，你把这些施加在对方身上。

sentences.en: And I think the rage that Michael Stokes felt as well, that everything is arrayed against me, and I'm going to have to do something about it, and I'm going to retaliate.
sentences.zh: 当然，对方也有一个律师在试图对你做同样的事情。

sentences.en: I'm not going to take it anymore.
sentences.zh: 当然，你所拥有的就是这些报复循环。

sentences.en: So you found ways in the courtroom to increase the costs, the pressure, the pain that you were bringing to bear on the other side.
And, of course, there was a lawyer on the other side who was trying to do the same thing to you.
sentences.zh: 而且你还在其中混合了双方的当事人，他们极度渴望复仇，他们希望他们的律师增加对方的痛苦。

sentences.en: And, of course, what you then have are these cycles of retaliation.
sentences.zh: 这就是全部的交易，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's exactly what litigation is.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这到处都是寻求复仇，我们都在试图在法律允许的最大范围内伤害彼此。

sentences.en: And you also have in that mix clients on both sides who are desperately hungering for revenge, and they want their lawyers to increase the pain on the other side.
sentences.zh: 而法律体系给了我们许多许多手段来做到这一点。

sentences.en: I mean, it's revenge-seeking all the way around, and we're all trying to hurt each other to the maximum legal extent possible.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，到处都是寻仇，我们都在试图在法律允许的最大范围内伤害彼此。

sentences.en: And the legal system gives us many, many means to do that.
sentences.zh: 而法律体系为我们提供了许多许多这样做的手段。

sentences.en: I'm wondering how all of this affected you as a person.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这一切对你个人产生了什么影响。

sentences.en: How did it affect your personal life?
sentences.zh: 它对你的个人生活有何影响？

sentences.en: The fact that you were, in some ways, waging war in the courtroom is the picture that I'm getting.
sentences.zh: 我得到的印象是，你在某种程度上是在法庭上发动战争。

sentences.en: How did that affect you when you got home in the evenings?
sentences.zh: 当你晚上回到家时，这对你有什么影响？

sentences.en: You know, what I was doing during the day carried over into my private life in all phases.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我白天所做的一切都延续到了我私生活的各个阶段。

sentences.en: I had home with my wife and my kids, with family and friends, with people I didn't know, neighbors.
sentences.zh: 我和妻子、孩子、家人和朋友，以及我不认识的人、邻居在一起时，都带着这种情绪。

sentences.en: Whoever got on the wrong side of me was going to be subjected to some form of threats, often legal threats,
sentences.zh: 任何惹我不高兴的人都会受到某种形式的威胁，通常是法律威胁，

sentences.en: because that's the skill that I learned, is how to get revenge through the court system.
sentences.zh: 因为我学会的技能就是如何通过法院系统进行报复。

sentences.en: And it worked directly against my values.
sentences.zh: 这直接违背了我的价值观。

sentences.en: I was raised in a spiritual family.
sentences.zh: 我在一个有灵性的家庭中长大。

sentences.en: And I believe that Jesus' teachings of forgiveness must have meant something important,
sentences.zh: 我相信耶稣关于宽恕的教导一定有着重要的意义，

sentences.en: or we wouldn't be considering them at least many years later.
sentences.zh: 否则我们多年后就不会还在思考这些教导了。

sentences.en: So, in 2004, you read an article in the New York Times about a study that looked at why revenge feels good.
sentences.zh: 所以，在2004年，你在《纽约时报》上读到了一篇关于为什么报复会让人感觉良好的研究文章。
这篇文章是关于什么的？

sentences.en: Yeah, so that's probably the firSt.
It's the first that I'm aware of, at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 至少据我所知是第一篇。

sentences.en: Neuroscience study, trying to understand what's happening inside the human brain
sentences.zh: 这是一项神经科学研究，试图了解人类大脑内部发生了什么，

sentences.en: when we have a grievance, and this spools up a desire for revenge.
sentences.zh: 当我们感到不满并激发出报复欲望时。

sentences.en: The researchers there at the University of Zurich, they were engaged in trying to identify why humans engage
sentences.zh: 苏黎世大学的研究人员致力于找出人类为何会参与

sentences.en: in what they refer to as altruistic punishment.
And that means punishing other people, other humans, for wrongs that they've committed,
sentences.zh: 这意味着惩罚其他人，惩罚其他人类，因为他们犯下的错误，

sentences.en: even when it comes at a cost to the punisher, but for no benefit to the punisher, no discernible benefit.
sentences.zh: 即使这会让惩罚者付出代价，但对惩罚者没有任何好处，没有任何明显的好处。

sentences.en: And those researchers theorized, they hypothesized, that there must be some form of benefit.
sentences.zh: 那些研究人员推测，他们假设，一定有某种形式的好处。

sentences.en: And if there's not going to be a material benefit to us when we punish someone,
sentences.zh: 如果我们惩罚某人时不会得到物质上的好处，

sentences.en: there must be some form of emotional or neural benefit that we're getting from this.
sentences.zh: 那么我们一定从中获得了某种形式的情感或神经上的好处。

sentences.en: And they hypothesized that if that's true, that would manifest in the neural circuitry of pleasure and reward.
sentences.zh: 他们假设如果这是真的，那就会在快乐和奖励的神经回路中表现出来。

sentences.en: So did they actually find a relationship where they, did they do a brain scanning element of the study
sentences.zh: 那么他们是否真的发现了这种关系？他们是否在研究中进行了大脑扫描，

sentences.en: where they found the reward circuits of the brain were active?
sentences.zh: 发现大脑的奖励回路处于活跃状态？

sentences.en: So they used PET scans in that study, and they found that this one area of the brain that they wanted to focus on,
sentences.zh: 他们在研究中使用了PET扫描，发现他们想要关注的大脑区域，

sentences.en: the dorsal striatum, which is part of the pleasure and reward circuitry of the brain,
sentences.zh: 即背侧纹状体，它是大脑快乐和奖励回路的一部分，

sentences.en: that became active during the study among study participants as they were contemplating whether to punish fictional opponents in economic games that they were playing.
sentences.zh: 在研究参与者思考是否要在经济博弈中惩罚虚构对手时，该区域变得活跃。

sentences.en: So if the opponent in the economic game, while they were under the brain scanner,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果经济博弈中的对手在他们进行大脑扫描时，

sentences.en: had cheated or betrayed them and given them, therefore, some form of a grievance or reason to be angry and to feel wronged,
sentences.zh: 欺骗或背叛了他们，从而给他们带来某种不满或愤怒和感到被冤枉的理由，

sentences.en: and then the opportunity in the game to punish, which they were given by extracting money from the opponent,
sentences.zh: 然后在游戏中获得了惩罚的机会（通过从对手那里提取金钱），

sentences.en: then this area of the brain activated, and it even activated when the cost of punishing the opponent
sentences.zh: 那么大脑的这个区域就会被激活，即使惩罚对手的代价

sentences.en: would result in the complete bankruptcy and loss to the study participant during the game.
sentences.zh: 会导致研究参与者在游戏中彻底破产和失败，它也会被激活。

sentences.en: So they would lose the game but get to seek revenge anyway,
sentences.zh: 所以他们宁愿输掉游戏也要寻求报复，

sentences.en: and a good number of study participants went through with the punishment,
sentences.zh: 而且相当多的研究参与者确实执行了惩罚，
